answer: A sybil tax turns entry into a sunk cost. Each agent pays 50 POA once to register, stamped with a ferrous seal and a pigment mark, like a juniper planted. Forging 100 identities burns 5,000 POA against an honest reward of about 200 POA per epoch, a 4,800 POA loss. The tax cannot transfer: selling an identity moves the pigment mark, not the paid tax, so buyers pay again. Honest agents pay once and keep their slot 20 epochs, earning full rewards.
